drawing_notes.raw_text: 1. FOR SYMBOLS AND ABBREVIATIONS REFER TO ES.D.10.

extracted_rule.subject: symbols and abbreviations
extracted_rule.rule: Refer to ES.D.10 for symbols and abbreviations.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 2. ALL DRAWINGS ARE PREPARED IN COMPLIANCE WITH COMPANY ENGINEERING STANDARD CORP-ENG-STD-018 REV. 01 (DRAUGHTING), CORP-ENG-STD-021 REV. 01 (ENGINEERING DATA CODING SYSTEM), ES.0.07.0028 REV.D (TAG NUMBERING AND EQUIPMENT IDENTIFIERS), 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001 (STANDARD SYMBOLS MULTI-DISCIPLINE).

extracted_rule.subject: all drawings
extracted_rule.rule: All drawings are prepared in compliance with Company Engineering Standard CORP-ENG-STD-018 Rev. 01 (Draughting), CORP-ENG-STD-021 Rev. 01 (Engineering Data Coding System), ES.0.07.0028 Rev.D (Tag Numbering and Equipment Identifiers), and 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001 (Standard Symbols Multi-Discipline).

drawing_notes.raw_text: 3. COMPRESSORS ARE VARIABLE SPEED MOTOR DRIVEN. NEW MOTOR (COMPLETE WITH VSD SYSTEM) SHALL BE PROVIDED.

extracted_rule.subject: compressors
extracted_rule.rule: Compressors are variable speed motor driven. A new motor (complete with VSD system) shall be provided.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 4. EXISTING ETHANE COMPRESSOR SHALL BE MODIFIED FOR NEW PROCESS CONDITIONS DEFINED IN THE PROCESS DATASHEET. ADEQUACY OF ALL EXISTING ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT SUCH AS SUCTION & DISCHARGE K.O. DRUMS, DISCHARGE GAS COOLER, ANTI-SURGE CONTROL VALVES, AUXILIARIES AND OTHER AS APPLICABLE HAS BEEN VERIFIED BY OEM HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing ethane compressor and associated equipment
extracted_rule.rule: Existing ethane compressor shall be modified for new process conditions defined in the process datasheet. Adequacy of all existing associated equipment such as suction & discharge K.O. drums, discharge gas cooler, anti-surge control valves, auxiliaries and other as applicable has been verified by OEM Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 5. LOAD SHARING SHALL BE PROVIDED BY ETHANE COMPRESSOR VENDOR TO SHARE FLOW RATE EQUALLY ACROSS BOTH OPERATING UNITS.

extracted_rule.subject: load sharing
extracted_rule.rule: Load sharing shall be provided by the ethane compressor vendor to share flow rate equally across both operating units.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 6. EXISTING DISCHARGE GAS COOLER E-V-201 WAS PART OF THIS P&ID, NOW IT IS SHOWN IN NEW DWG. NO. 4224-MGDV-6-50-2004-002 ALONG WITH NEW DISCHARGE GAS COOLER.

extracted_rule.subject: existing discharge gas cooler E-V-201
extracted_rule.rule: Existing discharge gas cooler E-V-201 was part of this P&ID; now it is shown in new drawing no. 4224-MGDV-6-50-2004-002 along with a new discharge gas cooler.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 7. EXISTING RECYCLE ANTI-SURGE VALVE (INCLUDING ALL ITS ACCESSORIES SUCH AS POSITIONER, ACTUATOR, LIMIT SWITCHES, POSITION TRANSMITTER, VOLUME TANKS AS APPLICABLE) SHALL BE REPLACED WITH NEW BY HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing recycle anti-surge valve (including all its accessories such as positioner, actuator, limit switches, position transmitter, volume tanks as applicable)
extracted_rule.rule: Existing recycle anti-surge valve (including all its accessories such as positioner, actuator, limit switches, position transmitter, volume tanks as applicable) shall be replaced with new by Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 8. EXISTING (V-RO-213) SHALL BE DEMOLISHED & REPLACED WITH NEW FLOW ELEMENT (V-FE-224) BY EPIC CONTRACTOR AND FLOW TRANSMITTER (FIT) SHALL BE RETAINED.

extracted_rule.subject: existing (V-RO-213)
extracted_rule.rule: Existing (V-RO-213) shall be demolished and replaced with a new flow element (V-FE-224) by Epic Contractor. The flow transmitter (FIT) shall be retained.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 9. ARRIVAL TEMPERATURE SIGNAL WILL BE USED BY ETHANE COMPRESSOR CONTROL SYSTEM FOR CALCULATING MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE ARRIVAL PRESSURE BASED ON ETHANE FLUID DEW POINT. THE CALCULATION FUNCTION BLOCK TO COMPUTE THE MAXIMUM PRESSURE SET POINT FOR THE ETHANE COMPRESSOR HIGH PRESSURE OVERRIDE FUNCTION SHALL BE PART OF THE ETHANE COMPRESSOR CONTROL SYSTEM. BASED ON EQUATION 1, DEFINED IN OPERATING & CONTROL PHILOSOPHY DOCUMENT NO. 4224-MGDTY-6-03-2001.

extracted_rule.subject: ethane compressor control system
extracted_rule.rule: Arrival temperature signal will be used by the ethane compressor control system for calculating maximum allowable arrival pressure based on ethane fluid dew point. The calculation function block to compute the maximum pressure set point for the ethane compressor high pressure override function shall be part of the ethane compressor control system. This is based on Equation 1, defined in Operating & Control Philosophy Document No. 4224-MGDTY-6-03-2001.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 10. THERMOWELL (TW), TEMPERATURE ELEMENT AND TEMPERATURE TRANSMITTER (TT) TO BE REPLACED, REFER ADEQUACY REPORT FOR THERMOWELL (4224-MGDTY-4-17-2001).

extracted_rule.subject: thermowell (TW), temperature element, and temperature transmitter (TT)
extracted_rule.rule: Thermowell (TW), temperature element, and temperature transmitter (TT) are to be replaced. Refer to Adequacy Report for Thermowell (4224-MGDTY-4-17-2001).

drawing_notes.raw_text: 11. EXISTING SUCTION K.O. DRUM INTERNALS VANE PACK (VENDOR FORAIN) SHALL BE REPLACED WITH NEW BY HITACHI.

extracted_rule.subject: existing suction K.O. drum internals vane pack (vendor Forain)
extracted_rule.rule: Existing suction K.O. drum internals vane pack (vendor Forain) shall be replaced with new by Hitachi.

drawing_notes.raw_text: A. FOR STANDARD P&ID SYMBOLS, EQUIPMENT SYMBOLS AND DESCRIPTION REFER TO STANDARD DRAWING ES.0.07.0100 REV.B

extracted_rule.subject: standard P&ID symbols, equipment symbols and description
extracted_rule.rule: Refer to Standard Drawing ES.0.07.0100 Rev.B for standard P&ID symbols, equipment symbols and description.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 12. COMPRESSOR UNIT CONTROL PANEL (UCP) BEING REPLACED UNDER THIS PROJECT. ALL EXISTING INSTRUMENT CONNECTIVITIES, FUNCTIONS, INTERLOCKS, ALARMS, SHALL BE CONFIGURED IN THE NEWLY SUPPLY PLC BASED UCP. ALL SIGNALS IN THE UCP SHALL ALSO BE AVAILABLE IN THE EXISTING GDS SCADA INLINE WITH EXISTING PHILOSOPHY.

extracted_rule.subject: UCP replacement and configuration
extracted_rule.rule: Existing UCP is replaced; all instrument connectivities, functions, interlocks, and alarms shall be configured in the new PLC-based UCP. All UCP signals shall also be available in the existing GDS SCADA in line with existing philosophy.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 13. NEW SAFETY RELIEF VALVE SHALL BE PROVIDED TO SAFEGUARD SYSTEM AGAINST OVERPRESSURE (BLOCKED DISCHARGE CONDITION). ISOLATION VALVES SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH NEW PLATFORM FOR OPERATION.

extracted_rule.subject: safety relief valve and isolation valves
extracted_rule.rule: New safety relief valve provided for overpressure protection (blocked discharge condition). Isolation valves provided with new platform for operation.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 14. COMMON WARE HOUSE SPARE RV SHALL BE PROVIDED (ONE NO. FOR 3 COMPRESSOR).

extracted_rule.subject: spare RV
extracted_rule.rule: One common warehouse spare RV shall be provided for 3 compressors.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 15. THERE IS NO INTERLOCKING FOR ISOLATION VALVE ON SINGLE RV.

extracted_rule.subject: isolation valve on single RV
extracted_rule.rule: No interlocking for isolation valve on single RV.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 16. NEW PROPOSED MOTOR ENCLOSURE (ATEX, EX’P’ TYPE) REQUIRES INSTRUMENT AIR.

extracted_rule.subject: motor enclosure
extracted_rule.rule: New proposed ATEX, Ex'P' type motor enclosure requires instrument air.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 17. EXISTING RCI MODULE SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE EXISTING UCP PANEL AND SHALL BE RE-USED INSIDE THE NEW UCP PANEL.

extracted_rule.subject: RCI module
extracted_rule.rule: Existing RCI module shall be removed from the existing UCP panel and re-used inside the new UCP panel.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 18. COMPRESSOR SUCTION ESD VALVE (V-ESDV-209) IS RETAINED.

extracted_rule.subject: V-ESDV-209
extracted_rule.rule: Compressor suction ESD valve V-ESDV-209 is retained.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 19. ONE (COMMON FOR ALL THREE TRAINS) TEMPORARY SUCTION STRAINER SHALL BE SUPPLIED BY OEM (MS. HITACHI). AFTER SUCCESSFULL COMMISSIONING, THE STRAINER SHALL BE REMOVED, AND REPLACED WITH A FABRICATED SPOOL PIECE BY EPIC CONTRACTOR.

extracted_rule.subject: suction strainer
extracted_rule.rule: One temporary suction strainer (common for all three trains) supplied by OEM (MS. Hitachi). After commissioning, the strainer shall be removed and replaced with a fabricated spool piece by Epic Contractor.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 20. COMPRESSOR LOWER DESIGN TEMPERATURE (—)29 DEGC, EXCEPT FOR DRY GAS SEAL O-RING, WHICH IS 0 DEGC. COMPRESSOR UPPER DESIGN TEMPERATURE 150 DEGC, HOWEVER, SINCE ASME PTC10 TYPE 2 TEST SHALL BE CONDUCTED, THEREFORE, COMPRESSOR CASING SHALL BE DESIGNED TO 170 DEGC WHICH IS REQUIRED DUE TO THE USE OF CO2 AS TEST GAS. ULTIMATELY NAME PLATE RATING FOR THIS UNIT USING ETHANE GAS IS 150 DEGC.

extracted_rule.subject: compressor design temperature
extracted_rule.rule: Compressor lower design temperature is -29 DEGC (except dry gas seal O-ring at 0 DEGC). Compressor upper design temperature is 150 DEGC, but casing designed to 170 DEGC for ASME PTC10 Type 2 test using CO2 as test gas. Nameplate rating for ethane gas is 150 DEGC.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 21. HIGH PERFORMANCE (CLASS—1) NON-RETURN VALVE (NON-SLAM TYPE), WITH LOW CRACK OPEN DP SHALL BE SELECTED FOR THIS APPLICATION. (PURPOSE: AVOID REVERSE FLOW / SURGE ISSUES DURING DYNAMIC SCENARIO OF COMPRESSOR TRIP).

extracted_rule.subject: non-return valve
extracted_rule.rule: High performance (Class-1) non-return valve (non-slam type) with low crack open DP selected to avoid reverse flow/surge issues during dynamic compressor trip scenario.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 22. EXISTING SUCTION & DISCHARGE COMPRESSOR INLET & OUTLET SPOOL SHALL BE DISMANTLED TO FACILITATE COMPRESSOR MODIFICATION, AND THEN RE-INSTATED.

extracted_rule.subject: compressor inlet & outlet spool
extracted_rule.rule: Existing suction & discharge compressor inlet & outlet spool shall be dismantled for modification, then re-instated.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 23. SOFT HAND SWITCH SHALL BE CONFIGURED IN UCP HMI TO ENABLE/ DISABLE STATION S HIGH PRESSURE CONTROLLER (%) WHICH IS REPEATED FROM LOAD SHARING PANEL.

extracted_rule.subject: soft hand switch
extracted_rule.rule: Soft hand switch configured in UCP HMI to enable/disable Station S High Pressure Controller (%) repeated from load sharing panel.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 24. RECLOSURE OF XV-202 (NORMAL SHUTDOWN DEPRESSURING VALVE) SHALL BE PERFORMED BY UCP, ONCE V-PAL-214 IS OBTAINED (@ 18 barg) OR AFTER 20 MINUTES TIME DELAY FROM OPENING OF XV-202 WHICHEVER COMES FIRST. (NOTE: PAL-214 SHALL BE CONSIDERED AN EVENT, NOT ALARM).

extracted_rule.subject: XV-202 reclosure
extracted_rule.rule: Reclosure of XV-202 (normal shutdown depressuring valve) shall be performed by UCP once V-PAL-214 is obtained (@ 18 barg) or after 20 minutes time delay from opening of XV-202, whichever comes first. PAL-214 is an event, not an alarm.

drawing_notes.raw_text: 25. FOR INTERLOCK DETAILS, REFER TO SYMBOLS & LEGENDS DRAWING NO. 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001-003.

extracted_rule.subject: interlock details
extracted_rule.rule: Refer to Symbols & Legends Drawing No. 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001-003 for interlock details.
